about_the_game:
Office Chug is a wacky survival game about climbing the corporate ladder while outrunning your past. You play as an ex-alcoholic determined to prove himself in the workplace. But every promotion comes with more pressure—and the temptation to “chug” your way through the day never really goes away.

Your mission: balance productivity and chaos. Chugging makes time fly and tasks finish faster, but if the boss catches you slacking, it’s game over.

Features

  • Step into the shoes of an ex-alcoholic on a goofy redemption quest.

  • Each level unlocks new bosses, tougher tasks, and crazier office antics.

  • Chug to speed up time and climb the ladder quicker—but always watch your back.

  • Silly physics and chaotic office humor keep every workday unpredictable.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains alcohol use as a core gameplay mechanic, with characters drinking to speed up time and earn promotions.

It features comic violence, including situations where the boss may shoot the player with a shotgun if caught drinking, resulting in small, cartoonish blood splashes. Characters can also stumble, fall, or collide with objects in a humorous way.

There is no sexual content or depiction of sexual assault, and no self-harm. The humor is satirical and exaggerated, but players should be aware that the game contains cartoon violence and chaotic office scenarios.
